title: Narra 4.1.35 — Player and offline polish
message: Install 4.1.35 over your current Narra app to keep your library, downloads, and settings. This update refines the player panels and free-user ad flow, keeps downloaded items reachable through the offline library, and improves the CubeTV promotion.
changelog: Update over your current Narra app without uninstalling to keep local data.
Player server, subtitle, and episode panels are more compact in landscape.
Free-user episode ad handling and fallback have been refined.
Downloaded items remain reachable through the offline library when live checks cannot connect.
The CubeTV promotion on Home is easier to read.
